references.text: Repeats the concept of the place the Lord will choose to put his name there, where the Israelites shall bring their offerings.
Refers again to the place the Lord your God chooses to put his name there.
Mentions the place the Lord chooses to put his name, in connection with tithes.
The Passover offering must be brought to the place the Lord chooses to put his name there.
The Passover offering must be slaughtered at the place the Lord your God chooses to put his name.
The Feast of Weeks must be celebrated at the place the Lord your God chooses to put his name.
The first fruits must be brought to the place the Lord your God chooses to put his name there.
Solomon prays toward the temple as the place where God said his name would be.
God confirms that he has consecrated the temple and set his name there forever.
Solomon acknowledges that he has built a house for the name of the Lord to dwell in.
The Lord has chosen Zion as his dwelling, the place he desires to live.
Jesus speaks with the Samaritan woman about the place of worship, pointing toward a new spiritual worship.
